events.factual_description: Kawasaki Shimin Plaza presents Plaza Afternoon Jazz Vol.21 FINAL on Saturday, October 3, 2026, in the Furusato Theater. Doors are at 13:30 and the performance begins at 14:00. The venue describes it as the final performance of the Plaza Afternoon Jazz series after roughly five years. Part 1 is the Masahiko Satoh Trio with Hideaki Kanazawa and Shun Ishiwaka, featuring violinist Keisuke Ohta. Part 2 is the Tsuyoshi Yamamoto Trio with Hiroshi Kagawa and Toshio Osumi, expanded by alto saxophonist Takuya Osumi. The venue lists advance general admission at JPY 5,000, day-of-show general admission at JPY 5,500, U25 student tickets at JPY 2,000 advance / JPY 2,500 day-of-show, and a JPY 9,000 pair ticket. All seating is unreserved.

en.why_it_matters: The reason is not simply two famous pianists on one bill. A roughly five-year Kawasaki series is ending, and its final program is built as two deliberately expanded working groups: Masahiko Satoh's trio gains Keisuke Ohta's violin, then Tsuyoshi Yamamoto's trio gains Takuya Osumi on alto saxophone. With Shun Ishiwaka in Satoh's rhythm section and veteran swing voices around Yamamoto, the afternoon becomes a compact cross-generational map of Japanese jazz rather than a routine double bill.
en.trip_verdict: If October 3 overlaps Tokyo or Kanto, protect the afternoon and build the day around Kawasaki. Because it is a 14:00 matinee, it can still leave the evening open in Tokyo; the finality of the series is what makes this worth locking in.

es.why_it_matters: La razón no es simplemente juntar a dos pianistas famosos. Una serie de Kawasaki de aproximadamente cinco años llega a su final y lo hace con dos grupos de trabajo ampliados de manera deliberada: el trío de Masahiko Satoh suma el violín de Keisuke Ohta y después el trío de Tsuyoshi Yamamoto incorpora el alto de Takuya Osumi. Con Shun Ishiwaka dentro de la sección rítmica de Satoh y voces veteranas del swing alrededor de Yamamoto, la tarde funciona como un mapa compacto y generacional del jazz japonés, no como un doble cartel rutinario.
es.trip_verdict: Si el 3 de octubre coincide con Tokio o Kanto, protegería la tarde y armaría el día alrededor de Kawasaki. Al ser una función de las 14:00 todavía deja libre la noche en Tokio; el cierre definitivo de la serie es lo que hace que valga la pena fijarla.

priority_review.rationale: Concrete scarcity: Kawasaki Shimin Plaza explicitly identifies this as the final performance of the Plaza Afternoon Jazz series after roughly five years, and the finale is built as a one-day two-part special program pairing Masahiko Satoh's trio plus Keisuke Ohta with Tsuyoshi Yamamoto's trio plus Takuya Osumi. The second editorial challenge asked whether A+ would still capture the recommendation; for a listener already in Tokyo/Kanto, it would understate the genuine regret of missing the final installment of a series that cannot recur as an ongoing series after this date. S+ was rejected because the source does not present this as a farewell, retirement, or final career appearance by Yamamoto, Satoh, or the other musicians; the singularity belongs to the series finale, not to the end of an artist's performing life.

events.factual_description: Roulette and Interpretations present a two-ensemble bill on Thursday, December 3, 2026. Doors are at 19:00 and the performance begins at 20:00. The first ensemble is Gerry Hemingway on percussion, Lina Andonovska on flutes, Earl Howard on saxophone and synthesizer, plus a special guest to be announced. The second is Kyle Motl on double bass, Eli Wallace on piano, and Nick Neuburg on drums and percussion. The event continues the 37th season of the Interpretations series, which focuses on relationships between contemporary composers and interpreters. Roulette lists $20 general admission in advance or at the door and $15 student/senior admission with ID. A free livestream is scheduled for 20:00 and is to be archived.

en.why_it_matters: The double-bill architecture gives this a real live premise. Hemingway, Andonovska and Howard put percussion, flute, saxophone and electronics into a chamber-improvisation space; Motl, Wallace and Neuburg answer with an acoustic bass-piano-percussion trio. Inside Interpretations' long-running composer/interpreter framework, the contrast is less about genre labels than about how two small ensembles organize sound, attack and spontaneity.
en.trip_verdict: If New York is already in play on December 3, attend if convenient and let Roulette be the experimental stop in the evening. I would combine it with another New York reason rather than make a corridor trip solely for this bill.

es.why_it_matters: La arquitectura del doble cartel le da una premisa en vivo muy concreta. Hemingway, Andonovska y Howard ponen percusión, flauta, saxofón y electrónica dentro de un espacio de improvisación de cámara; Motl, Wallace y Neuburg responden con un trío acústico de contrabajo, piano y percusión. Dentro del marco de compositores e intérpretes que Interpretations lleva décadas construyendo, el contraste importa menos por las etiquetas de género que por la manera en que dos grupos pequeños organizan sonido, ataque y espontaneidad.
es.trip_verdict: Si Nueva York ya está en juego el 3 de diciembre, iría si acomoda y dejaría que Roulette sea la parada experimental de la noche. Lo combinaría con otra razón para estar en la ciudad en vez de hacer el viaje por el corredor únicamente por este cartel.
